views.description: The views whose counts the badge adds up, each a view of views.

default_sort.description: What clients call a view's own order in the sort menu, such as "View order". Required in the bundled profile; a user layer may replace it.

empty.description: What a view without its own empty shows when it lists nothing, over the view's label as `{{.label}}`. Required in the bundled profile; a user layer may replace it.

additionalProperties.description: A facet, by its id. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones.

label.description: The text people read; the id when absent.

within.description: How long ago an instant may be and still fall in the bucket.

buckets.description: For a facet that sorts by time: the buckets its instants fall in, by id, in the order the file declares them; the first whose within covers the time since the instant wins, and one with no within takes the rest.

empty.description: What a group of tasks with no value shows.

fact.description: The fact the facet reads: a fact of a task (task.*, task.prop.*), or a field of a record kind, written <kind>.<field> (brief.risk). Required.

group.description: Whether a list can group by the facet.

label_prefix.description: Text before the label of each value of a facet whose order the catalog derives, such as the `@` of a context; a label that has it already keeps it.

match.description: How a filter's text matches a value: the whole value, its last segment, its first, or a person's team.

menu.description: Whether the facet is offered in the filter menu.

merge.description: How a task's value joins its units' rows' values: union adds it to them, rows-first uses it only when no row has a value.

rank.description: The facet's values in their order, first first.

sort.description: How the facet's values order: by rank, as text, or as instants (time). Absent, as text.

strip.description: Whether each row's strip is colored by the facet's first value, its rank the strip's legend.

units.description: Which of a task's units contribute rows' values: all of them, or the primary unit alone.

values.description: The text people read for a value, by value.

facets.description: The task facets, by id: the fields every client filters, groups and sorts tasks by, in the order the file declares them, a user layer's new ones after the bundled. A plugin's row facet of the same id must agree on group, sort, match and buckets.

lens.description: What every list's lens bar says. Each is a template whose only actions are the `{{.name}}` its doc lists, which the clients fill in. Required in the bundled profile; a user layer may replace any.

board_group.description: The group menu's entry for the field a board groups by when nothing is picked, over the field's label as `{{.label}}`.

copied.description: What Copy list says it copied, over `{{.count}}` items and the `{{.view}}` they came from.

copied_grouped.description: What Copy list says it copied from a grouped list, over `{{.count}}`, `{{.view}}` and the `{{.group}}` field's label.

default_group.description: The group menu's entry for the field a view groups by on its own, over the field's label as `{{.label}}`.

no_group.description: The group menu's entry that lists the view in one group.

additionalProperties.description: A step of the review, by the view it walks, which views declares. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones, and comes after the steps below it.

label.description: What the step asks of you, as the review lists it. Required.

review.description: The review's steps, in the order the review walks them.

additionalProperties.description: A view, by its name. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones.

empty.description: What the view shows when it lists nothing; the top-level empty when absent. A filter that matches nothing says so in its own words.

group.description: The fact the view groups by, such as task.owed_by.

hide_disabled.description: The view hides the tasks whose units are all of a disabled plugin, and the gates on a disabled plugin's units.

key.description: The key that jumps to the view: `g`, a space and a key that no core key uses, such as `g i`. Its help is the view's label, and its help line the view's summary.

label.description: The name people read in the list of views. Required.

over.description: What the view lists: tasks, or gates.

remove_clean.description: The view offers to remove at once the workspaces its tasks' links hold whose checkouts hold nothing that is not published, as each link's remove action does; the rest are kept, with why.

sort.description: The facts the view sorts by, comma-separated; a leading - sorts one descending. A view's tasks start oldest first, a parent's children in their sibling order.

summary.description: One line on what the view lists: its tooltip in the list of views, its subtitle, and its key's help line. Required.

when.description: Which tasks or gates the view lists, over their facts: a task's, its properties' (task.prop.*), or a gate's. A view with none lists nothing: a place in the clients' list of views that a client draws itself, such as the review.

views.description: The lists of tasks, by view.
